emma: Quick sync  can we land on a tiny "session manifest" that works for hosted/dedicated/private? Minimal fields: tenant_tag, affinity_hint, secret_ref (opaque), manifest_v, resolve_mode. Keep inline keys out except for explicit private opt-in.

ryan: +1. Add `fallback_hint` (degrade|route|fail) and `migration_grace` for affinity moves. Also require `audit_nonce` and `telemetry_tag` (HMAC) so logs are safe.

security-bot: policy note: hosted = no inline keys by default. Any manifest with inline key material must be allowlisted and security-reviewed. Manifests must be signed and include ttl <= 600s.

emma: Error classes proposal: RESOLVE_RETRYABLE, RESOLVE_PERMANENT, POLICY_VIOLATION. Map to deterministic behavior: retry/backoff, fallback-or-abort, abort+audit.

infra-bot: preflight checks queued: manifest-schema v2, migration-sim, kms-access-matrix.

ryan: I'll draft the compact JSON schema and a couple of example manifests (hosted vs private) and open a PR. If no objections I'll proceed. :thumbsup:

emma: :thumbsup:
